args.summary:
Average bill length (mm) for Adelie penguins by island: Biscoe 40.93, Dream 38.75, Torgersen 40.70 (13 Adelie penguins total).

Data quality work: The species column had 7 rows with label variants (case/space differences like "adelie", "Gentoo ", and misspellings like "Adeile", "Gentto", "Chinstarp"). I merged these into the allowed labels (Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo) with normalize_labels — this mattered because 2 Adelie rows would otherwise have been missed. The island column was clean, bill_length_mm had no missing values and all values were within the rules-file range (30–60 mm), and there were no duplicate rows.

Caveats: Other columns not used by this question still have issues (one negative flipper_length_mm of -200, and body_mass_g stored as text with comma-formatted numbers), but they don't affect this answer.
